content:
MARKET_A source can be converted and can pay GENERAL USD beneficiaries. MARKET_B can be converted and can pay GENERAL or LICENSED beneficiaries.

SERVICE can pay GENERAL only, CAPITAL can pay LICENSED only, and REIMBURSEMENT can pay either; these last three cannot be converted. The segment is recorded on each beneficiary.

The SOURCE-* profile articles define these terms and charges. Eligibility is a property of each allocated source and is unchanged by a quote or the aggregate account balance.
